title: Lossy slab, FDTD: cw absorption into transient heat, window lag and stored energy (analytic)
description:
The analytic_lossy_slab_heating strip in the time domain: a cw 1.55 um plane-wave mode (em_fdtd_ez mode_source, P_in = 2e5 W/m, ramped in by 1 - exp(-t / (3 T))) crosses a glass slab with sigma_e = 2e3 S/m; em_heat_joule hands the window-averaged absorbed power to an insulated transient heat physics stepped every 1008 EM steps (time_dependent, 64 heat steps, 2.98 ps). The EM time step is set (courant_factor) to exactly 1/112 of the optical period, so a heat window is exactly 18 half periods and its mean of sigma E^2 has no cw ripple. Conduction is made negligible (k = 0.05 W/(m K): ~2e-4 of the slab-edge rise over the run), so each cell stores its own absorbed energy.
Analytic: absorbed fraction A = (1 - R) (1 - exp(-a d)) (a = the power attenuation of the discrete FDTD wave: Yee dispersion in space and time, the time-averaged conductivity term sigma cos(omega dt / 2) / Omega), q(x) = q_front exp(-a (x - x0)) in the slab. Cadence: heat step k covers [k W, (k+1) W] with the power of [(k-1) W, k W] (the first one sourceless), so at heat time t the stored energy is that absorbed up to t - W; the ramp withholds 1.5 tau of power (tau = 3 T) and the wave reaches x after n0 (x - x_src) / c. Stored heat at the end: P_abs ((K - 1) W - 1.5 tau - t_abs), t_abs the absorption-weighted arrival delay (~12 fs). The cw flux spectra (power_per_cw over the whole run) see the arrival delay t_d too: x ((t_run - tau - t_d) / (t_run - tau))^2 (-1.9 % at the down monitor).
Derived values tab: P_front, P_trans (flux power_per_cw, ~1e-3), P_heat = integral of the coupled heat source heat.Q (the last window: the cw absorbed power, ~1e-3) and E_heat = integral rho cp T_rise (the stored energy; a missing or extra window lag is 1.6 %, the ramp and delay 1.2 %; expected ~1e-3, tolerance 2e-3).
Probes tab: T_front (slab front cell) with the dashed lagged ramp curve and the curve without the one-window lag. Line profile tab (end): Q_line = heat.Q and T_rise_line = heat.T_rise along the strip vs q(x) and q(x) ((K - 1) W - 1.5 tau - n0 (x - x_src) / c) / (rho cp); pointwise checks carry the standing-wave ripple of the slab back-face reflection (+-0.5 % at the front cell, more toward the back), tolerance 1e-2.

parameters.name: P_in
parameters.description: cw mode source power in W per m of z (2D), after the ramp

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: vacuum wavelength of the cw source

parameters.name: omega0
parameters.description: angular frequency in rad/s

parameters.name: n0
parameters.description: glass index (eps_r = n0^2, also inside the slab)

parameters.name: sigma_slab
parameters.description: optical conductivity sigma_e of the slab in S/m (weak loss, a d ~ 2)

parameters.name: x_slab0
parameters.description: slab front face (on a cell face)

parameters.name: d_slab
parameters.description: slab thickness along x

parameters.name: x_slab1
parameters.description: slab back face

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: strip length along x (CPML outside for EM, insulated heat faces)

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: period along y (periodic EM boundaries, insulated heat faces)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size; the lines below sit at cell centres

parameters.name: x_src
parameters.description: mode source line (cell 50 centre), launching toward +x

parameters.name: x_flux_up
parameters.description: upstream flux monitor (cell 65 centre): net power into the slab

parameters.name: x_flux_down
parameters.description: downstream flux monitor (cell 335 centre): transmitted power

parameters.name: x_probe
parameters.description: temperature probe x: the first slab cell centre

parameters.name: steps_half_period
parameters.description: EM time steps per half optical period (sets the time step)

parameters.name: courant_em
parameters.description: courant_factor giving dt = T / 112 (0.979 of the 2D CFL limit)

parameters.name: dt_em
parameters.description: EM time step in s (46.2 as)

parameters.name: heat_every
parameters.description: EM steps per heat step = 18 half periods (must equal the heat physics every)

parameters.name: n_heat_steps
parameters.description: heat steps K in the run

parameters.name: window_heat
parameters.description: heat window W = 9 optical periods in s (46.5 fs)

parameters.name: t_end
parameters.description: study duration in s (64512 EM steps, 2.98 ps)

parameters.name: k_glass
parameters.description: thermal conductivity in W/(m K), low on purpose (silica 1.4 would spread the slab-edge cell by ~6e-3)

parameters.name: rho_glass
parameters.description: density in kg/m^3

parameters.name: cp_glass
parameters.description: specific heat in J/(kg K)

parameters.name: rho_cp
parameters.description: volumetric heat capacity in J/(m^3 K)

parameters.name: T0
parameters.description: initial and reference temperature in K

parameters.name: Omega_d
parameters.description: discrete-time frequency (2 / dt) sin(omega dt / 2) of the Yee update in rad/s

parameters.name: k_time
parameters.description: vacuum wavenumber seen by the time-discrete update in 1/m

parameters.name: eps_imag
parameters.description: Im eps of the slab in the semi-implicit conductivity update

parameters.name: eps_abs
parameters.description: |eps| of the slab

parameters.name: kappa
parameters.description: extinction coefficient Im sqrt(eps) of the slab

parameters.name: n_re
parameters.description: Re sqrt(eps) of the slab

parameters.name: ksi0
parameters.description: half-cell phase n0 k dx / 2 (spatial grid-dispersion factor)

parameters.name: a_att
parameters.description: power attenuation coefficient of the discrete wave in 1/m (a d ~ 2.0)

parameters.name: R_front
parameters.description: power reflection of the slab front face (~4e-4)

parameters.name: exit_factor
parameters.description: back-face power transmission over (1 - R) for a wave leaving an absorbing medium

parameters.name: A_ref
parameters.description: absorbed fraction (back-face reflection and interference neglected, ~1e-4)

parameters.name: P_abs_ref
parameters.description: analytic cw absorbed power in W/m

parameters.name: q_front
parameters.description: cw absorbed power density at the slab front in W/m^3

parameters.name: tau_ramp
parameters.description: cw ramp time constant 3 T in s (15.5 fs)

parameters.name: delay_up
parameters.description: arrival delay at the up monitor in s

parameters.name: delay_down
parameters.description: arrival delay at the down monitor in s (28.5 fs)

parameters.name: dft_up
parameters.description: whole-run DFT factor of the delayed wave at the up monitor

parameters.name: dft_down
parameters.description: whole-run DFT factor of the delayed wave at the down monitor

parameters.name: depth_mean
parameters.description: absorption-weighted mean depth into the slab in m

parameters.name: delay_abs
parameters.description: absorption-weighted arrival delay t_abs in s

parameters.name: t_heated
parameters.description: effective full-power heating time of the stored energy in s

parameters.name: E_heat_ref
parameters.description: analytic stored heat at the end in J/m

parameters.name: q_probe
parameters.description: cw absorbed power density at the probe cell centre in W/m^3

parameters.name: delay_probe
parameters.description: arrival delay at the probe in s

analytic_curves.name: lagged_ramp
analytic_curves.expression: T0 + q_probe/rho_cp*where(t - window_heat - delay_probe > 0, (t - window_heat - delay_probe) - 2*tau_ramp*(1 - exp(-(t - window_heat - delay_probe)/tau_ramp)) + tau_ramp/2*(1 - exp(-2*(t - window_heat - delay_probe)/tau_ramp)), 0)

analytic_curves.name: no_window_lag
analytic_curves.expression: T0 + q_probe/rho_cp*where(t - delay_probe > 0, (t - delay_probe) - 2*tau_ramp*(1 - exp(-(t - delay_probe)/tau_ramp)) + tau_ramp/2*(1 - exp(-2*(t - delay_probe)/tau_ramp)), 0)

analytic_curves.name: Q_line
analytic_curves.expression: where(x > x_slab0, where(x < x_slab1, q_front*exp(-a_att*(x - x_slab0)), 0), 0)

analytic_curves.name: T_rise_line
analytic_curves.expression: where(x > x_slab0, where(x < x_slab1, q_front*exp(-a_att*(x - x_slab0))*((n_heat_steps - 1)*window_heat - 1.5*tau_ramp - n0*(x - x_src)/c_const)/rho_cp, 0), 0)
